I want to know
how it works.

Especially where people, data and complex rules meet.

I’m a first-year student at Central University and work on backend systems at T-Bank. In my own projects, I explore ideas I want to turn into useful tools.

CODY began with a desire to continue work from a phone. BPMN.space asks whether a document can become a process without hiding important assumptions.
